title: 日本ダービーの後に・アイツの姿

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Daiwa Scarlet places well in the Japanese Derby.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: However, after the race, she can't shake the feeling that Vodka's stirring performance was true number one material.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Daiwa Scarlet proclaims she will retake the number one spot from Vodka, lest her rival get too far ahead.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Next up is the Shuka Sho, the last race of the Triple Tiara.
